1.t: Have We not expanded thee thy breast?-

2.t: And removed from thee thy burden

3.t: The which did gall thy back?-

4.t: And raised high the esteem (in which) thou (art held)?

5.t: So, verily, with every difficulty, there is relief:

6.t: Verily, with every difficulty there is relief.

7.t: Therefore, when thou art free (from thine immediate task), still labour hard,

8.t: And to thy Lord turn (all) thy attention.
